name: Türkiye Kalkinma ve Yatirim Bankasi A.S.
summary: Türkiye Kalkinma ve Yatirim Bankasi A.S. operates as a development and investment banking company in Türkiye. It operates through Investment Banking, Corporate Banking, and Other segments. The company provides financial solutions and banking services to medium and large-scale joint stock company customers, investment loans, project financing, TL and foreign currency-based business loans, letters of credit, and guarantees and collateral.
